description.narrative: - Contributing to the preservation and promotion of indigenous knowledge on medicinal plants of the Red Dao people in Ta Ngao village, Bat Xat commune, Lao Cai province, through teaching, systematizing knowledge, developing livelihoods, and enhancing therole of women in the indigenous medicinal plant value chain, linked with forest protection, biodiversity conservation, climate change adaptation, and greenhouse gas emission reduction. - Implemented over 17 months from the date the project is financially approved. - The project is committed to implementing the principles of equity and inclusion, ensuring that all vulnerable groups in the community—particularly women, girls, Red Dao people, people with disabilities, and poor households—have the opportunity to actively participate,have their voices heard, and contribute to shaping and benefiting from the project’s outcomes in a fair and sustainable manner - The direct beneficiaries of the project: (i) Participating farming households, the direct beneficiaries of the project; (ii) The Farmers’ Association and relevant stakeholders. - The project is designed and planned to be implemented to achieve six key result groups: + Activities and outputs for Result 1: The area of native medicinal plant rawmaterial zones is restored. + Activities and outputs for Result 2: Indigenous knowledge on medicinal plants of the Red Dao people is systematized and preserved. + Activities and outputs for Result 3: Production capacity is strengthened, and participating households develop livelihoods from medicinal plants. + Activities and outputs for Result 4: Establish a women-led professional farmers’ group model that applies indigenous knowledge and scientific-technological methods for the safe and high-quality processing of medicinal plants according to market requirements. + Activities and outputs for Result 5: Market linkage and OCOP product development. + Activities and outputs for Result 6: Households inthe village are equipped with knowledge on preserving and promoting ethnic cultural identity, gender equality, as well as forest protection and the development of understory medicinal plants.

participating-org.narrative: Lao Cai province Farmers Association is a socio-political organization, mass organization of the peasant class led by the CommunistParty of Vietnam, a member of the Vietnam Fatherland Front, with the role of gathering, uniting, representing and protecting the interests of peasants, the core of the peasant movement and the cause of new rural construction. The Association helps farmers improvetheir qualifications, supports production, business, cares for their lives and participates in building the Partyand government. The Association has the following functions: 1. Gathering, propagating, educating, and mobilizing members and farmers to promote theirownership rights, actively study to improve their qualifications and capacity in all aspects. 2. Caring for and protecting the legitimate and legal rights and interests of members and farmers; organizing service activities, consulting, and supporting farmers in production, business, and life. 3. Representing the farmer class in participating in buildingthe Party, the State, and the great national unity.
